light.line: Level Up Lebanon just wrapped its biggest season yet, with Wards 1 and 4 residents hauling off roughly 200 cars' worth of cleanup this fall. Neighborhood pride, measured by the truckload.
A church in Lebanon built a wheelchair ramp for neighbor Tiffany Walker, who lives with a rare condition called Ehlers-Danlos Syndrome, to make her daily life easier. Love thy neighbor, with lumber.
LifePoint West Church projected a giant 'GO BUCKSKINS' message on its building to cheer on Joel E. Barber's very first homecoming football game. Talk about a church with spirit.

Shine Through Faith, a Marshfield nonprofit founded by Heather Rodriguez, started by mowing yards and grabbing groceries for older neighbors and has grown into a resource center for families, foster kids and teachers. Small favors, big ripple.

Bathsheba Chapter 14, King Solomon Lodge 15 and UKHFI Temple 203 donated 50 headphones and clothing for school nurses' offices to Waynesville elementary students on Oct. 20. Quiet classrooms, happy teachers.
